name: What is the typical process for coordinating fixture installation with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for coordinating fixture installation with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for coordinating fixture installation begins during the design phase, where we assist with selections and review specifications. Once approved, we create a detailed procurement schedule, tracking lead times and delivery dates. We then coordinate with our team and relevant subcontractors (e.g., plumbers, electricians) to ensure they are ready for installation upon delivery. This systematic approach ensures all trades are synchronized, and fixtures are installed efficiently and correctly as part of the overall construction project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves fixture selection, detailed procurement scheduling, tracking deliveries, and coordinating with trades for efficient and correct installation.
